subject: general
question:
The following pie charts show the data of the number of appeared and passed students of class 12 in sections A, B, C, D and E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af383b5da5b9a77b41332db232ac41bccecfa9c296a54b3e34570d2910836532.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5228e26d63ed43e4ecf8571203077c5c531543a0eac81998336fdebaceb3168.png] 

Find the difference between the number of students who appeared for the exam in sections A and B.
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total number of appeared students = 1800 student

⇒ 360° = 1800

⇒ 1° = 1800/360 = 5 students

Appeared students of section A = 42° = 42 × 5 = 210 students

Appeared students of section B = 50° = 50 × 5 = 250 students

Required difference = (250 - 210) = 40 students

**∴ The correct answer is 40 students.**
